title: New ways to buy ChatGPT ads

facts.fact: In the first phase of the pilot, advertisers could buy ChatGPT ads on a CPM (cost-per-mille impressions) basis.
facts.quote: In the first phase of the pilot, advertisers could buy ChatGPT ads on a CPM (cost-per-mille impressions) basis

facts.fact: OpenAI is adding cost-per-click (CPC) bidding for ChatGPT ads, and OpenAI states that advertisers are only charged based on a click outcome.
facts.quote: Advertisers are only charged based on a click outcome.

facts.fact: OpenAI states it will continue to support both CPM and CPC buying for ChatGPT ads.
facts.quote: We’ll continue to support CPM and CPC buying

facts.fact: OpenAI is beginning to roll out a beta self-serve Ads Manager that lets advertisers sign up and purchase ChatGPT ads directly.
facts.quote: Today, we’re beginning to roll out a beta self-serve Ads Manager that allows advertisers to sign up and purchase ads directly to appear in ChatGPT.

facts.fact: In the beta Ads Manager, businesses can register as advertisers, add payment information, set budgets, bids and pacing, upload ads, launch and manage campaigns, and view performance.
facts.quote: Businesses can register as advertisers, add payment information, set budgets, bids and pacing, upload ads, launch and manage campaigns, and view performance in the portal.

facts.fact: OpenAI is gradually opening the beta Ads Manager to more businesses as it tests and refines the experience.
facts.quote: We’re gradually opening Ads Manager to more businesses as we continue to test and refine the experience.

facts.fact: OpenAI names Dentsu, Omnicom, Publicis, and WPP as agency partners collaborating to support businesses purchasing ChatGPT ads.
facts.quote: We have been collaborating with leading agency partners including Dentsu, Omnicom, Publicis, and WPP

facts.fact: OpenAI names Adobe, Criteo, Kargo, Pacvue, and StackAdapt as technology partners added for ChatGPT ads.
facts.quote: We’ve also added technology partners such as Adobe, Criteo, Kargo, Pacvue, and StackAdapt

facts.fact: Partners support campaign budgeting, bidding, and advertising creative for ChatGPT ads, while OpenAI's ads system controls all delivery decisions.
facts.quote: These partners help support campaign budgeting, bidding and advertising creative, while OpenAI’s ads system controls all delivery decisions.

facts.fact: OpenAI recently launched Conversions API and pixel-based measurement so advertisers can track actions such as purchases, leads, and sign-ups after engaging with an ad.
facts.quote: We recently launched Conversions API and pixel-based measurement

facts.fact: According to OpenAI, advertisers receive aggregated performance insights without access to individual conversations.
facts.quote: Advertisers receive aggregated performance insights that help them understand campaign impact, without access to individual conversations.

facts.fact: OpenAI states that ChatGPT's answers stay independent, conversations stay private, and users remain in control of their experience, as principles guiding its ads.
facts.quote: ChatGPT’s answers stay independent, conversations stay private, and users remain in control of their experience.

facts.fact: OpenAI says the Ads Manager is intended for companies of all sizes, from SMBs and startups to global brands.
facts.quote: Ads Manager makes it easier for companies of all sizes, from SMBs and startups to global brands, to grow their businesses via ChatGPT.
